causal_diagnosis: The policy optimizes a reward dominated by dense negative penalties (distance -41.95, vertical speed -20.36, angle -3.70) and a large terminal crash penalty (-100). The objective success bonus (100) is never reached because the policy never achieves the strict success conditions (both legs, near pad, low speed, upright). The dense penalties strongly discourage any movement toward the pad, causing the policy to prefer using orientation engines (actions 1 and 3) to drift sideways, leading to crashes. Action 0 (do nothing) is unused because the reward provides no incentive to coast or reduce fuel usage; the policy always fires engines. The horizontal_correction_bonus (mean 32.4) rewards using action 3 when vx*x>0, but this condition is often satisfied when drifting away from pad, so the policy farms this bonus without making progress toward the pad. The policy never achieves stable touchdown because it never reduces vertical speed near the pad (vy at terminal is often high, e.g., -0.67).
component_interaction_diagnosis: The distance penalty (-0.5 per unit) dominates the dense negative budget (-41.95 mean). Combined with the vertical speed penalty (-0.3 per unit) and angle penalty (-0.2 per radian), the total dense negative is -201.89, which is 201.89x the positive objective budget (0.0, since success is never achieved). The crash penalty (-100) further reinforces early termination. The interaction causes the policy to avoid moving toward the pad (which increases distance penalty) and to avoid using the main engine (action 2) to reduce vertical speed (which would increase vertical speed penalty if it causes high vy). The horizontal_correction_bonus (mean 32.4) is farmed by using action 3 when drifting away from pad, but this does not lead to centering because the policy does not use action 1 (left engine) to correct in the opposite direction. The policy therefore oscillates or drifts without making progress.
action_coverage_diagnosis: Action 0 (do nothing) is unused. This action is necessary for Phase 1 (descent and horizontal alignment) to allow the lander to coast without wasting fuel, and for Phase 3 (landing) to avoid overshooting the pad. Without it, the policy always fires engines, wasting fuel and causing instability. The current reward provides no incentive to use action 0; the fuel penalties (-0.03 for main, -0.01 for orientation) are too small to discourage constant engine use. The policy therefore never learns to coast or to stop firing when aligned.
